llm_top3.reasoning: INCY and KO both delivered clean beats with raised guidance and are making 52-week/all-time highs, the strongest fundamental confirmation in the list, even though they rank 6th and 19th quantitatively. UDR pairs a top-2 quant rank with a genuine FFO beat, raised 2026 outlook and a new monthly dividend. I skip NE (rank 3) despite its rank because the guidance cut and swing to a loss are strongly negative, and NSA because its acquisition has already closed leaving no forward upside.
